notes_for_editor: Only one page describes this tower (Central US Lookouts, undated) and it gives no build date, staffing, status or access. Two web searches found nothing about the tower itself. Source 2 is used only for the four-standing-towers list and the Trigg context; Grassy Knob is not on that list. The brief's name, county, height and agency agree with source 1, so no corrections are proposed. Story is short because the evidence is thin.
